zh.title: 紅蓮機甲騎士
zh.description: 披著烈焰紅披風的機甲騎士。六片洞洞板拼成 60 × 40 公分的大幅牆面，氣勢十足，也照樣掛得住日常小物。
zh.imageAlt: 六片八色實際列印洞洞板拼成機甲騎士頭部、紅色披風與「紅蓮」字樣
zh.sourceAlt: 原始機甲騎士插畫，紅色披風與「紅蓮」書法字

en.title: Crimson Mech Knight
en.description: A mech knight wrapped in a burning crimson cape. Six panels form a bold 600 × 400 mm wall that still holds your everyday gear.
en.imageAlt: Six eight-color printed pegboard panels forming a mech knight's head, a red cape and Chinese calligraphy
en.sourceAlt: Original mech knight illustration with a red cape and Chinese calligraphy

zh.title: 金鷹利刃
zh.description: 黑底與金色勾出俐落的鷹影，四片洞洞板拼成一面醒目的桌邊裝飾，也能掛上日常小物。
zh.imageAlt: 四片黑金雙色實際列印洞洞板拼成鷹形圖案與 FALCON 字樣
zh.sourceAlt: 原始黑金鷹形圖案與 FALCON 字樣

en.title: Golden Falcon
en.description: A sharp gold falcon against black. Four printed panels form a bold backdrop for your desk, with room to hang everyday essentials.
en.imageAlt: Four black and gold printed pegboard panels forming a falcon graphic and FALCON lettering
en.sourceAlt: Original gold falcon graphic and FALCON lettering on black

zh.title: 山湖夕陽
zh.description: 夕陽、山稜與湖面倒影，將戶外風景帶到你的工作角落。六種耗材、四片洞洞板，拼成一幅可以收納的風景。
zh.imageAlt: 四片六色實際列印洞洞板拼成夕陽山峰森林與湖面倒影
zh.sourceAlt: 原始山湖夕陽插畫，包含橘色太陽、山峰、森林與湖面倒影

en.title: Mountain Lake Sunset
en.description: Bring a little of the outdoors to your desk. Six filament colors and four printed panels turn a mountain sunset into a place for everyday essentials.
en.imageAlt: Four six-color printed pegboard panels forming a sunset above mountains, pine trees and lake reflections
en.sourceAlt: Original mountain lake sunset illustration with a striped orange sun, peaks, pine trees and reflections

zh.title: 像素火箭
zh.description: 火箭升空，穿過星星與行星。四片彩色洞洞板拼成一幅太空冒險，為孩子的房間或你的工作角落添一點想像。
zh.imageAlt: 四片實際列印的洞洞板拼成像素火箭、月亮、星星與地球
zh.sourceAlt: 原始像素插畫：火箭飛過月亮、星星與行星

en.title: Space Rocket
en.description: Blast off past stars and planets. Four colorful pegboard panels come together as a pixel-art space adventure, bringing a little imagination to a child’s room or your own creative corner.
en.imageAlt: Four printed pegboard panels form a pixel-art rocket, moon, stars and Earth
en.sourceAlt: Original pixel artwork of a rocket flying past the moon, stars and planets
